source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: During your [Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase), pick one or more of your ADEPTUS MECHANICUS units for HALO OVERRIDE, subject to the size cap. Embarked units qualify. Pick one stance for all units with HALO OVERRIDE. Both the keyword from this selection and the stance expire when your next [Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase) begins. Incursion allows one selection, Strike Force two and Onslaught three. Electromotive Energisation adds 2 inches of Move. Microactuator Bracing adds 1 Toughness. Predation Protocols permits charging after an [Advance](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move). Muted Servomotors gives the unit’s models [Stealth](vsdata:core-ability/stealth).
